relations.rationale: Practicing openings all week supports Jude being eager to try a new variation, as preparation naturally leads to eagerness to use it.
Practicing openings all week has no bearing on the arrival order of Ivo and Jude.
Jude's eagerness to try a new variation has no bearing on what scoring system is used for the match.
Jude's personal eagerness about a chess variation is unrelated to newer members' confusion about the rating system.
Jude's eagerness to try a new variation does not affect or indicate anything about arrival order with Ivo.
Using the standard rating system for the match could plausibly explain or relate to newer members finding that same system confusing.
The scoring system used for a match has no relation to Xavi's height and shelf access.
The scoring system for the next match is unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting.
Ivo arriving before Jude does not determine or relate to whether Tess arrived before Jude.
The advisor walking in briefly to check attendance is consistent with and supports the claim that the advisor also left scoresheets during that visit.
The advisor checking attendance is unrelated to Xavi's height helping him reach a shelf.
Scoresheets being left on a table is unrelated to whether games were finished by the end of the session.
Xavi being taller than most younger members supports the claim that his height helps him reach a higher shelf.
Games being unfinished at the end of the session is unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting before a tournament.
